svg.title: JGDMS corrected trust pipeline — proxy unmarshalling happens on clients not the lookup service
svg.desc: Corrected four-zone topology. Foreign service providers register their service item including codebase URL with the Jini lookup service on Host 1. The lookup service stores the registration opaquely without unmarshalling the proxy. Clients discover services from the lookup service and receive the marshalled service item. Each client runs ProxyCodebaseSPI locally which intercepts the codebase URL before unmarshalling begins, downloads the JAR, hashes it, and checks the VerdictRegistry on Host 3 directly. On cache miss the client's ProxyCodebaseSPI cannot itself dispatch to the BAE — instead the lookup service host runs a registration-time analysis pipeline using the BAE smart proxy to Host 2 and VerdictRegistry proxy to Host 3, so that by the time any client discovers a service the verdict is already in the registry. Clients that find a clean verdict in the registry proceed to unmarshal. Clients that find no verdict or a bad verdict refuse to unmarshal. All communications are JERI mutual auth.
svg.text: foreign service providers — untrusted, any OS
JERI · authenticated · marshalled service item + codebase URL

g.text: stores marshalled service items opaquely · does NOT unmarshal proxies
triggers analysis pipeline at registration time so verdict is ready before any client discovers the service
1. foreign service submits marshalled item + codebase URL
2. BAE proxy downloads JAR, hashes it, dispatches to Host 2
3. signed report returned, submitted to Host 3 via registry proxy

svg.text: network — JERI · mutual auth · no direct path Host 2 ↔ Host 3
clients connect to Host 1 (discovery) and Host 3 (verdict lookup) independently

g.text: no exec · no JNI · no FFM
any OS · inbound from Host 1 + clients
verify engine public key on submit

svg.text: client-side unmarshal flow (ProxyCodebaseSPI present on every client)
clients discover from Host 1, then unmarshal locally — this is where ProxyCodebaseSPI fires

g.text: Client host — any OS — ProxyCodebaseSPI present
1. discover service item from Host 1 (marshalled, opaque)
2. ProxyCodebaseSPI fires before unmarshal: hash JAR · lookup Host 3
3. clean verdict found → unmarshal proxy · use service
4. no verdict / bad verdict → refuse unmarshal · log · alert
5. defence in depth: verdict already in Host 3 from registration time
